Class FastaReader

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.importers.FastaReader
public class FastaReader extends Object
FASTA importer. Parses FASTA files into either a ReferenceImport (reference genome paired with BAM/CRAM input) or an unaligned WrittenGenomicRun (panel / target list / quality-stripped reads).

Gzip-compressed input is auto-detected via the 1f 8b magic bytes regardless of file extension.

FASTA records are header-line ">name [desc]" followed by one or more sequence lines until the next header or EOF. Header description (anything after the first whitespace) is dropped.

Cross-language equivalents: Python ttio.importers.fasta.FastaReader, Objective-C TTIOFastaReader.

    • readUnaligned

      public WrittenGenomicRun readUnaligned(String sampleName, String platform, String referenceUri, Enums.AcquisitionMode acquisitionMode) throws IOException
      Parse the file as a set of unaligned reads.

      Each FASTA record becomes one read with SAM-unmapped sentinel values. Qualities are filled with 0xFF (matching BamReader's "QUAL absent" convention).

      Throws:
      IOException

    • readUnaligned

      public WrittenGenomicRun readUnaligned(String sampleName, String platform, String referenceUri, Enums.AcquisitionMode acquisitionMode, ProgressSink progress) throws IOException
      Parse the file as a set of unaligned reads, emitting per-read ProgressSink callbacks.

      Fires progress.onProgress(done, -1L) every PROGRESS_INTERVAL_READS records during the parse phase (total is unknown until the trailing record flushes) and a final onProgress(total, total) once the count is known.

      Throws:
      IOException
      Since:
      1.5.0
